evals.prompt: Review my changes before I open a pull request.
evals.expected_output: Collects the diff and requirements, reviews in a separate pass or sub-agent, and reports correctness findings with file, line, and a concrete failing input.

evals.prompt: Review this diff: it only renames two variables.
evals.expected_output: Reports that no correctness findings survived instead of inventing issues or listing style preferences.

evals.prompt: Check that the new export feature matches docs/specs/export.md.
evals.expected_output: Compares the diff against each requirement in the spec and lists missing or partial requirements.
